scripts.check: for f in worker.js schema.js server/*.js pages/*.js public/*.js tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "for (const f of ['public/manifest.json','wrangler.json','package.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'))"
scripts.test: for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do echo "── $f"; node --no-warnings "$f" || exit 1; done
